AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Labely designs and prints labels on Bluetooth thermal label printers such as the NIIMBOT B21 Pro. Operational patterns: - A print is two steps: create and save a label with 'createLabelFromText' or 'createLabelFromTemplate', then print its labelId with 'printLabel'. - Call 'listTemplates' before 'createLabelFromTemplate' to get template ids and field names. - Call 'listPrinters' to get printer ids; set scan only when no printer is known, as it takes about 5 seconds. - To print several copies of one label, pass copies to one 'printLabel' call instead of calling it repeatedly. Constraints: - Printing uses paper and needs the user's one-time permission in Labely's settings. - Saved labels appear in the app's recent labels, so the user can edit them there.
